name: The Lost Dwarves
summary: Baelog waits in Uldaman, where he has a wager riding on seeing another living person. Find him before Olaf's beard reaches his knees.

sections.title: A Wager in Uldaman
sections.body: Baelog waits in Uldaman, hoping to settle a wager with Olaf. You are the living person he has been waiting to see. Olaf's beard still has inches to grow before it reaches his knees, and Baelog offers to share the winnings with you.

faq.q: Who is Baelog waiting to see?
faq.answer: Baelog has been waiting to see another living person.
Olaf wagered that his beard would reach his knees before he saw another living person.

faq.q: How much longer does Olaf's beard need to grow?
faq.answer: Olaf's beard has a few more inches to grow before it reaches his knees.
Baelog offers to split the wager's winnings with you.
